Sample: 6A 
Score: 9 
 
The student earned all 9 points. 
 
Sample: 6B 
Score: 6 
 
The student earned 6 points: 2 points in part (a), 3 points in part (b), and 1 point in part (c). In parts (a) and (b), 
the student’s work is correct. No supporting work was required. In part (c) the student appears to have 
antidifferentiated

not earn the fourth point. The student earned the third point because the answer has a constant term of 7 in a 
polynomial of degree three or higher.
